Step: 1405 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
240 days before 04-02-1405:  
Go back 4 months (approx 122 days) to 04-10-1404 (since 1404 is a leap year).  
Remaining days: 240 - 122 = 118 days earlier from 04-10-1404.  
118 days before 04-10-1404 is 1404-06-14 (Jan 31 + Feb 29 + Mar 31 + Apr 10 = 101 days, plus 17 days into June → June 14).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1404-06-14
